integrity: The all-parameter statement is proved by explicit boundary reductions and an integer winding functional. Finite-field computations are supplementary implementation checks and are not used as an infinite proof.
limitations: Only first integral regular path homology is determined; no higher-homology, chain-homotopy, or persistence claim is made. An unindexed equivalent computation under another tournament alias remains a residual literature risk.
title: Cyclic tournaments retain one integral first path-homology class
